title: Mine don't look like the picture
text: Mine don't look like the picture. Mine don't look like the picture... The four bags I received look more like the next size up which is huge - my bags each could hold all four of the bags in the picture. They're sturdy and I've used one for laundry and appreciate how easy it is now to carry several loads of wash up or down the basement stairs. I gave one to my daughter to also use for laundry...
